_about: Values measured on the tuning pairs that the record run uses (heidelberg/stages/derived.py); not to be edited by hand

tuning_background.source: the tuning pairs' chance estimate, 33.6250, over the 39 pairs selected

overdispersion.source: the pooled variance of the 8 shifts' chance counts over their mean, on the 39 pairs selected; its error from 4000 bootstrap resamples of the pairs

g_half_median.source: the median over the 39 pairs selected of the G at which star-like flashes are found at half the peak efficiency
